name: @herdchestra/host-cline
description: Herdchestra adapter for Cline: js-manager / js-worker / js-plan / js-review / fork / join as a Cline plugin. Shipped inside the herdchestra package; not published on its own, because its modules import ../core and ../compose and only resolve inside the root tree.
//files: A hand-written list drifted: it omitted plan-entry.mjs, handoff.mjs, plugin-session.mjs, role-fact.mjs, start-result.mjs, entry-path.mjs, fission.mjs, devops.mjs and README.md, so a package install that honours `files` dropped modules index.js imports. The directory is the unit; tests and `AGENTS.md` are repo-internal and do not ship (the root package excludes them the same way, and root §0.1 makes the root package the only installable unit). The glob must be `**/*`: `"."` and `"./"` pack only package.json and README.md (measured with `npm pack`).
